Hi all —

I dug into the onboarding records and the temporary fiscal token generated during provisioning is ART-TRN-20270609-19. That token was meant to map to spend cap bucket S-Transit-3 (monthly cap $18,000). It looks like the vendor invoice (0427) references spend bucket S-Transit-1 (monthly cap $5,000) which explains the mismatch.

Attachments: fiscal_token_mapping.csv (includes ART-TRN-20270609-19 mapping and spend-cap values).

Next steps I recommend:
1) TransitOne issues a corrected invoice referencing ART-TRN-20270609-19 and the S-Transit-3 line.
2) If TransitOne does not want to reissue, we can perform a manual remap in the ledger from S-Transit-1 -> S-Transit-3 for that invoice, but Finance will need sign-off (Ben).

Ben — please confirm if Finance can accept manual remap for this single invoice or if an updated invoice is required for audit.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Operations
